server.name: io.github.Marsmanleo/marsnme
server.description: Agent-agnostic memory backend that preserves continuity between humans and AI over time.
server.title: MarsNMe

environmentVariables.description: Profile ID used to separate memory data (for example: profile-a).
environmentVariables.name: MCP_PROFILE

environmentVariables.description: Supabase REST API project URL.
environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Supabase service role key.
environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Jina AI API key for embedding-based tools.
environmentVariables.name: JINA_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Local HTTP port for the MCP endpoint. If omitted, defaults by MCP_PROFILE (coco=18790, toto=18791, others deterministic in 20000-29999).
environmentVariables.name: PORT
